ch|order-of-malta: The Order of Malta and Switzerland are both a white cross on red. Switzerland's flag is square and its short cross stops well before the edges; the Order of Malta's flag is rectangular and its cross runs right to the edges.
dk|order-of-malta: The Order of Malta and Denmark are both a white cross on red running to the edges. Denmark's cross is shifted towards the hoist; the Order of Malta's sits in the exact centre.
eh|jo: Western Sahara and Jordan both have black, white and green stripes with a red triangle at the hoist. Jordan has a small white star in the triangle; Western Sahara has a red crescent and star on the white stripe.
eh|ps: Western Sahara and Palestine both have black, white and green stripes with a red triangle at the hoist. Western Sahara adds a red crescent and star on the white stripe; Palestine's stripes are plain.
ir|somaliland: Iran and Somaliland are both green, white and red horizontal stripes with Arabic writing. Iran has a red emblem in the centre and script along the stripe edges; Somaliland has white script on the green and a black star in the centre.
islamic-emirate|sa: The Islamic Emirate and Saudi Arabia both carry the Shahada in Arabic script. Saudi Arabia writes it in white on green above a sword; the Islamic Emirate writes it in black on plain white.
molossia|sl: Molossia and Sierra Leone are the same three stripes in reverse order. Sierra Leone has green on top and blue at the bottom; Molossia has blue on top and green at the bottom.
northern-cyprus|tn: Northern Cyprus and Tunisia both show a red crescent and star on white. Tunisia's sit in a white disc on a red field; Northern Cyprus is white all over with two thin red stripes.
northern-cyprus|tr: Northern Cyprus and Turkey both show a crescent and star. Turkey is a white crescent and star on red; Northern Cyprus reverses it to red on white and adds two thin red stripes.
sealand|tt: Sealand and Trinidad and Tobago both cross red with a diagonal of black and white. Trinidad and Tobago has a white-edged black band running down from the top left; Sealand has a white band rising to the top right, with red above it and black below.
